peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 14.4% above its local comparables; 116 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (60.2): 3.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 233 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Context, not scored: resales in 50% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,350,000 ($2,298 psf, 947–1,065 sq ft; 5 resales, May 2024–Apr 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,889 psf (range $1,486–2,730); 21.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $418,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $3,250,000 ($2,460 psf, 1,205–1,345 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,300 psf (range $1,757–2,432); 7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $211,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: King Albert Park MRT about 340 m, Sixth Avenue MRT about 1,160 m; closer than 484 of 662 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Methodist Girls' School (Primary) about 370 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 240 m), more than 177 of 662 similar developments (the same as 29); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Market about 1,300 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 610 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Turf City MRT about 1,020 m (LTA target 2032) and Maju MRT about 1,050 m (LTA target 2032), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 650 m; Dunearn House, 237 new sales, about 770 m; The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,230 m; 8@BT, 34 new sales, about 1,370 m; Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 1,930 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 66 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 355 new sales and 276 resales (631 purchases); new sales were 56.3% of these purchases. Subsales (45) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 660 m; Dunearn Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 660 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 276 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 53 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 276 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 309 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.7%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
